A Note on the Effect of Auxiliary Information on the Variance of Cluster Sampling. Journal of Official Statistics 25(3):397-404, 2009. https://www.scb.se/contentassets/ca21efb41fee47d293bbee5bf7be7fb3/a-note-on-the-effect-of-auxiliary-information-on-the-variance-of-cluster-sampling.pdf. Auxiliary information lowers the conditional intra-cluster correlation; anticipated design effect for GREG depends on rho_e and average cluster size N*. Compares to SRS of elements only, not to stratified sampling; no optimal cluster size; no cost.

Kennel TL, Valliant R. Robust variance estimators for generalized regression estimators in cluster samples. Survey Methodology 45(3), released 2019-12-17. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/12-001-x/2019003/article/00001-eng.htm. Leverage-adjusted sandwich and jackknife variance for GREG in two-stage samples. Variance estimation only; no allocation or cost. Related dissertation: Kennel 2013, Univ. of Maryland, https://drum.lib.umd.edu/handle/1903/14064.
bears_on: C3 and C2 as methodology background (design-based GREG variance in two-stage samples)
